name: Wolf
flavour: It followed the smell of trouble all the way here.
art_prompt: a real grey wolf with thick grey fur, darker charcoal-grey fur along its back and the top of its tail, pale cream fur on its chest, belly, legs and muzzle, amber eyes, a black nose and pointed upright ears, four legs, standing on all fours facing the viewer, its bushy tail low behind it
doc: A fast runner in packs of four (pass 151, from Garry's 3D wolf, walked on its own clip in eight directions): about a hellhound's pace with less health. On no row yet.

WOLF-A.note: Pass 151: as close to the 3D model as it gets: the model's clay repainted with little freedom (img2img 0.7), no style anchor, a realistic grey wolf

recipe.blockout: a rough grey 3D model of a wolf: a long narrow muzzle, two upright pointed ears, a deep chest, a lean body, four long thin legs ending in paws and a long bushy tail, prowling with its head held low; its flat facets and jagged fur tufts are only the model's rough surface, not part of the wolf
recipe.anatomy: exactly four legs, two front legs and two hind legs, each leg one single continuous limb ending in one paw, exactly one head with one long muzzle and two pointed ears, exactly one bushy tail, one body, no extra legs

words.side: seen from the side and a little above: its head with the long muzzle at the right end, held low, the bushy tail at the left end, the four long legs below the body
words.front: seen from the front and a little above, walking straight towards the viewer: its head with the muzzle at the bottom middle, nearest the viewer, held low, the body behind and above it, the front legs at both sides of the chest, the tail hidden behind the body, the whole body narrow, not turned sideways
words.fd: seen three-quarters from the front and a little above, walking towards the lower right: its head and muzzle at the lower right, nearest the viewer, the body and the bushy tail at the upper left, farther away
words.bd: seen three-quarters from behind and a little above, walking away towards the upper right: its hindquarters and bushy tail nearest the viewer at the lower left, the head farther away at the upper right, partly hidden
words.back: seen from straight behind and a little above, walking straight away from the viewer: its hindquarters nearest the viewer in the middle, the bushy tail hanging down the middle of the picture towards the viewer, the head beyond the shoulders with only the ear tips showing, the whole body narrow, not turned sideways

recipe.motion: prowling in place on its four long legs like a real wolf: the legs step in diagonal pairs, each paw lifting, swinging forward and planting again, the head held low and level, the bushy tail swaying a little
recipe.anim_negative: extra legs, five legs, six legs, three legs, legs merging, a second tail, two heads, a second wolf, standing upright, ghost legs, transparent legs, smeared legs, blurry legs
recipe.death_motion: its legs buckle, it collapses onto its side and lies dead stretched out on its side, its four legs limp and reaching towards the viewer, its eyes closed, its tail flat on the ground
recipe.dead: lying dead on its side, stretched out, its four legs limp
